title: Prem Deewane
desc: Radha and Manohar elope after her father opposes their love, unaware that her uncle-pretending to support them-harbors sinister plans of his own.

title: Jaal: The Trap
desc: Ajay is forced to kidnap Anita, the home minister's daughter, to save his girlfriend Neha from terrorists. But during the mission, he uncovers a shocking truth.

title: Traffic Signal
desc: Silsila, a street-smart young man who manages various trades at a Mumbai traffic signal, sees his life crumble when he unknowingly helps execute a murder.

title: Laila Majnu
desc: Qais and Laila fall in love in Kashmir but face family opposition. Fate separates them-Laila marries another man while Qais moves to London, heartbroken.

title: Robot 2.0
desc: In Chennai, When Dr Vaseegaran And His Humanoid Robot, Nila, Are Summoned To Help Save The City From The Destructive Pakshi Rajan, A Bird-Shaped Being, He Reinstates Chitti.

title: Murder 2
desc: Arjun, a former cop, takes on the case of missing sex workers. To catch the culprit, young Reshma bravely steps in as bait-risking everything to expose the truth.

title: Mukkabaaz
desc: Aspiring boxer Shravan Singh clashes with Bhagwan Das Mishra, the powerful head of a boxing federation. Matters escalate when Shravan falls for Bhagwan's niece, Sunaina.

title: Goodbye
desc: A family unravels after the sudden death of the mother. As the children rush home for her final rites, clashing opinions ignite tensions, exposing deep-rooted conflicts.

title: Taal
desc: Mansi rises to fame with Vikrant's help after being insulted. But when her ex apologises and wants her back, she must choose between past pain and present success.

title: Lal Badshah
desc: Lal Singh stands up to underworld leader Vicky Baadshah, but chaos unfolds when his past emerges and he's found to resemble a prince who once hid a precious treasure.

title: Khamoshiyan
desc: Kabir, a struggling writer seeking inspiration in Kashmir, stays at a mysterious guest house and falls for Meera, its owner, unaware she is hiding a dark secret.

title: Fukrey 3
desc: The Fukras dream of ruling Delhi and contesting elections, but with no money, they take up an international job for quick cash-setting off a wild adventure that changes their lives.

title: Bachchhan Paandey
desc: Myra picks dreaded gangster Bachchhan Paandey as the subject of her film, but her plan spirals when the terrifying hooligan decides he wants to star in the movie himself.

title: Tehran
desc: After a 2012 Delhi bombing, officer RK's Tehran mission turns deadly when Iran targets him and India abandons him in his quest to expose the truth.

title: Akhanda
desc: When the nefarious Varadarajulu targets Murali Krishna, a devoted follower of Lord Shiva, Akhanda steps in and goes to any extent to defeat the evil.

title: Yuvraaj
desc: After Deven and Danny learn their late father left all his wealth to their brother Gyanesh, who has special needs, they plot a way to take control of the inheritance.
